description: Pro Jet GEO/SEO scorecard rubric. Eight mandatory weighted subscores, each 0-100. Weights are percentages of the overall 0-100 score and must sum to 100. Sources that are unavailable are reported with status 'unavailable', their observed coverage percentage and their unknown overall contribution; they are never silently scored zero and the total is never silently renormalized without a label.

scoring_rules.missing_data: status=unavailable; report coverage and unknown_contribution=weight; optional labeled renormalized_score over measured weight only
scoring_rules.provisional: scores from partial sources must set status=provisional and state the coverage percentage

subscores.what: canonicals, robots, sitemap, redirects, 404 handling, HTTPS, indexability
NAP consistency, service-area facts, local structured signals, service-area content
valid JSON-LD types relevant to a service-area plumber, required properties, no invented facts
unique titles/descriptions, H1s, service depth, honest business facts
llms.txt accuracy, quotable fact statements, clear service/contact structure
working inquiry paths, honest status/fallback, click-to-call/text, quote flow
labels/alt/skip links, mobile viewport, motion controls, asset weight discipline
observed citations/answers in ChatGPT web search, Google AI Overviews, Gemini, Perplexity; requires separate live observation evidence
